prompt.en: Njeri has 2,000 shares, 8,000 savings and a 5,000 loan. Can you infer a 10,000 immediate withdrawal right?
prompt.sw: Njeri ana hisa 2,000, akiba 8,000 na mkopo 5,000. Unaweza kusema ana haki ya kutoa 10,000 sasa?

label.en: No; inspect separate contracts, lawful terms and liquidity
label.sw: Hapana; kagua mikataba, masharti halali na upatikanaji

explanation.en: Shares, deposits and loans are distinct relationships; totals alone do not establish withdrawal rights.
explanation.sw: Hisa, amana na mikopo ni mahusiano tofauti; jumla haithibitishi haki ya kutoa.

label.sw: Udhibiti wa wanachama wa kidemokrasia na uwajibikaji

explanation.en: Principles guide governance; actual lawful procedures still need verification.
explanation.sw: Kanuni huongoza utawala; taratibu halali bado zihakikiwe.

prompt.en: Does using a shared Bitcoin wallet automatically create a cooperative institution?
prompt.sw: Kutumia pochi ya Bitcoin ya pamoja huunda taasisi ya ushirika moja kwa moja?

label.en: No; organization, rights, obligations and law must be established
label.sw: Hapana; muundo, haki, wajibu na sheria vibainishwe

label.en: Yes, all wallet users become insured members
label.sw: Ndiyo, wote huwa wanachama wenye bima
Ndiyo, sahihi huchukua nafasi ya utawala wa sheria

explanation.en: Technology does not by itself create a charter, elected board or member protections.
explanation.sw: Teknolojia peke yake haiundi hadhi, bodi iliyochaguliwa au ulinzi.

prompt.en: What does member ownership fail to guarantee?

label.en: That members have an institutional stake
label.sw: Kwamba wanachama wana sehemu ya taasisi

label.en: Freedom from fraud, losses or insolvency
label.sw: Kutokuwepo kwa udanganyifu, hasara au kufilisika

explanation.en: Ownership needs controls, reporting, participation and independent review.
explanation.sw: Umiliki unahitaji udhibiti, ripoti, ushiriki na ukaguzi huru.
